subcategory.instructions: This is an Irish planning application description. Descriptions rarely say 'wind farm' or 'solar farm': a wind farm appears as 'N turbines', permission for X years for N turbines, tip height changes; a solar farm appears as ground-mounted solar PV panels or arrays, hectares of panels. Which subcategory best describes the main purpose of this development?

criteria.hybrid: Two or more of wind / solar / battery storage in the same application, 1 MW or more in total.
criteria.wind: Wind turbines or a wind farm (onshore or offshore) of 1 MW or more: installation of N turbines, permission or extension of permission for N turbines, turbine replacement (repowering), extensions.
criteria.solar: Ground-mounted solar PV installation (solar farm) of 1 MW or more.
criteria.bess: Battery energy storage system as the main development, any size.
criteria.substation: Electricity substation (new or upgraded) serving the grid or generation.
criteria.energy_support: Construction works that give relevant support to energy projects: national roads, electricity cables to substations, substation extensions to serve wind or solar farms (ground-mounted solar). It must be a construction work; the wind or solar farm itself is wind or solar.
criteria.leu: Large energy user: factories, industrial complexes, housing developments of 200 or more homes in a single application.
criteria.not_energy: Everything else, including fences, car parks, buildings that are not substations, depots and warehouses, even when they are part of a wind farm, a solar farm or a large energy user.
criteria.low_energy: Low energy: wind / solar / hybrid under 1 MW; housing schemes of fewer than 200 homes; generation from other sources (biomass, diesel, gas, CHP, etc.) of any size; small substations inside houses, schools or supermarkets; rooftop solar panels; electric vehicle charging points.

category.instructions: This is an Irish planning application description. Descriptions rarely say 'wind farm' or 'solar farm': a wind farm appears as 'N turbines', permission for X years for N turbines, tip height changes; a solar farm appears as ground-mounted solar PV panels or arrays, hectares of panels. Is this an energy development?

criteria.energy: Energy development: hybrid, wind, solar, battery storage, hydro, substation, construction works supporting energy projects, large energy user or data centre.
criteria.not_energy: Not an energy development, or only low energy (small renewables under 1 MW, fewer than 200 homes, other generation sources, rooftop solar, EV chargers).
